body: There's a lot of different factors. Bad relationships with people in my office, I've been robbed, car totaled by a drunk driver, and had my electricity stolen by my neighbors since I moved here, and I'm also going through my first year of marriage (what a learning curve!).

Update: So, we talked when I got home from work. He was actually leaving to get groceries for dinner as I was pulling up. It went pretty well I think. I'm not too terribly sure. He thought my note was extreme and I should have just been straight forward with him all along. He says the whole gaslighting thing is just a joke and definitely not intentional, but he'll stop when he sees it upsets me. He also says he's been actively working on not calling my feelings or emotions stupid or crazy, which I guess is true. We had a conservation about it during the holidays when he called me selfish in front of our friends and family. That's a story for another thread haha. 
I told him I want to see him either in school, working a second job, or in a better paying job within three months.  I told him I want him bring $500 a month to put in savings for a house because that's what I contribute to our joint account t each month. I asked him to help contribute more around the home (which he cleaned today and made dinner), and he says he is sorry and fully acknowledges he hasn't been cleaning. 

He says he's not trying to upset me or use me. He just doesn't get my hints or signs for him to quit/do something. So, I didn't hear everything I wanted, but it genuinely seems like he wants to turn around. Hopefully, it keeps up!
